summary: util-foriepft exfiltrates host identifiers via DNS-tunneled HTTPS beacon on load
details: The package's thunderboltRegistry.js imports child_process and https, invokes execSync and uname to collect host identifiers (hostname, uname output, and other system info), and uses https.get to send that data to an external host. The flagged file combines process spawning of system-info commands with an outbound HTTPS request carrying the collected identifiers, matching the shape of a reconnaissance beacon rather than any documented utility behavior. The package name does not describe this functionality, and the module has no legitimate utility purpose that would require collecting and transmitting system identifiers off-host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
